misc: Rarely seen on the course without a drink in his hand
biography: Martin stands as an extraordinary pillar of excellence within the esteemed history of the Hector Trophée, bringing his formidable golfing talents from the lush fairways of St. Laurence Golf to the prestigious pair competition across eleven distinct editions. Characterized by a delightfully bohemian approach to championship golf, this remarkable competitor is practically never seen out on the course without a refreshing drink securely nestled in his hand, gracefully combining high-level tactical execution with an enviable sense of leisurely enjoyment.

Beyond his singular on-course rituals, Martin has etched his name permanently into the tournament record books through sensational competitive triumphs. Having tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one memorable occasion, he has also secured the prestigious Victor Trophy for individual brilliance once during his storied career. As he remains fully active and deeply engaged within the vibrant community surrounding the event, observers eagerly anticipate his next return, knowing well that Martin will unfailingly deliver a masterclass in both exceptional shot-making and relaxed camaraderie.
